name: mixmax-quarterly-gtm-report
description: End-to-end automated quarterly GTM revenue reporting for Mixmax. Fresh-cut analysis from quarterly Gen 1 snapshots with 5 human-in-the-loop checkpoints. Produces four reports per close: Quarterly Wrap-Up (org), CRO Quarterly (CRO-only), Quarter-Ahead (next-quarter setup), and Board Snapshot (one-page executive). Distributes via GitHub Pages, Notion, and Slack.
